title: LTO-7 orders drivers to explain viral Cebu road rage incident

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Land Transportation Office in Central Visayas (LTO-7) ordered the registered owner and designated driver of a vehicle involved in a viral road rage incident to explain their actions, suspending the driver’s license and placing the vehicle under alarm. LTO-7 issued a Show Cause Order (SCO) after a video circulated on social media showing a traffic confrontation involving a pickup and a motorcycle. The footage appeared to show one of the motorists repeatedly attempting to stab the other with a bladed object during the altercation.
